source_title: West Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Raising Full-Year Net Sales and Adjusted-Diluted EPS guidance
EXTON, Pa. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. (NYSE: WST ), a leading provider of innovative, high-quality injectable solutions and services, today announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026.
Third-Quarter 2026 Summary (comparisons to prior-year period)
Net sales of $874.5 million increased 8.7%; organic growth was 11.9%.
Diluted earnings per share ("EPS") of $3.02 increased 57.3%.
Adjusted-diluted EPS of $2.66 increased 35.7%.
The Company repurchased $231 million of stock in the quarter, bringing the year-to-date total to $685 million.
Year-to-date operating cash flow was $403 million. Capital expenditures were $125 million.
The Company also announced on October 19, 2026, that its Board of Directors declared a fourth-quarter dividend of $0.26 per share, an increase of 18% over the $0.22 per share paid in the prior quarter.
Full-year 2026 net sales guidance increased to a range of $3.41 billion to $3.42 billion, up from the previous range of $3.345 billion to $3.380 billion.
Full-year 2026 adjusted-diluted EPS guidance increased to a range of $9.38 to $9.48, up from the previous range of $8.85 to $9.05.
Michel Lagarde, President and Chief Executive Officer, commented: "I am pleased to report strong third-quarter 2026 results, with net sales and adjusted EPS exceeding our expectations. Our results were again led by our High-Value Product (HVP) Components business. The robust sales performance drove strong operating income margin expansion and EPS growth. As a result of our team's strong execution in the third quarter, we are increasing our full-year 2026 guidance."
Mr. Lagarde concluded: "I want to thank our global teams for their relentless focus on execution to deliver products and services for our customers and the patients they serve. West is a critical primary containment and drug delivery partner for pharmaceutical companies, biotechs and CDMOs around the world. We are grateful for the trust our customers put in us, and we remain committed to driving continuous improvement to even better serve their current and future needs."
Proprietary Products Segment Net sales of $728.8 million grew by 12.6% and increased 16.6% on an organic basis.
High-Value Product ("HVP") Components net sales of $466.7 million increased 19.7% and rose 20.3% on an organic basis. HVP Components accounted for 53% of total company net sales in the quarter.
HVP Delivery Devices net sales of $99.1 million were flat, and were up 26.4% on an organic basis excluding foreign currency translation effects and the impact of the divestiture of SmartDoseÂ® 3.5mL. HVP Delivery Devices accounted for 11% of total company net sales in the quarter. SmartDoseÂ® 3.5mL net sales represented $11.8 million in the quarter and $29.8 million in the prior-year quarter and are excluded from both periods to calculate organic growth.
SmartDoseÂ® 3.5mL net sales represented $11.8 million in the quarter and $29.8 million in the prior-year quarter and are excluded from both periods to calculate organic growth.
Standard Products net sales of $163.0 million increased by 2.9% and rose 3.1% on an organic basis. Standard Products accounted for 19% of total company net sales this quarter.
West Vantage Segment Net sales of $145.7 million decreased by 7.3% and declined 6.6% on an organic basis. West Vantage accounted for 17% of total company net sales in the quarter.
The Company is increasing its full-year 2026 net sales guidance range to $3.41 billion to $3.42 billion, up from the previous range of $3.345 billion to $3.380 billion. Organic net sales growth guidance increased to a range of 11.3% to 11.6%, up from the prior range of 10% to 11%. SmartDoseÂ® 3.5mL generated $55.3 million in net sales in the second half of 2025 and generated $11.8 million in net sales in the third quarter of 2026. No additional SmartDoseÂ® 3.5mL product sales are expected for the remainder of the year. These net sales are excluded in both periods to calculate full-year 2026 organic growth.

About West West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. is a leading provider of innovative, high-quality injectable solutions and services. As a trusted partner to established and emerging drug developers, West helps ensure the safe, effective containment and delivery of life-saving and life-enhancing medicines for patients. With over 10,000 team members across 50 sites including 26 manufacturing facilities worldwide, West helps support our customers by delivering over 41 billion components and devices each year. Headquartered in Exton, Pennsylvania, West in its fiscal year 2025 generated $3.07 billion in net sales. West is traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: WST ) and is included in the Standard & Poor's 500 index. For more information, visit www.westpharma.com .

Non-U.S. GAAP Financial Measures The Company reports its financial results in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("U.S. GAAP"). However, management also uses certain non-U.S. GAAP financial measures in evaluating our results of operations. Management believes that this information provides users with a valuable insight into our overall performance and financial position. As a result, this release contains certain non-GAAP financial measures, including organic net sales, adjusted-diluted EPS and adjusted operating profit. Organic net sales exclude the impact from acquisitions and/or divestitures and translate the current-period reported sales of subsidiaries whose functional currency is other than the U.S. Dollar at the applicable foreign currency exchange rates in effect during the comparable prior-year period. We may also refer to financial results, such as adjusted-diluted EPS and adjusted operating profit, that exclude the effects of unallocated items. The unallocated items are not representative of ongoing operations, and generally include restructuring and related charges, certain asset impairments, and other specifically identified income or expense items. These non-U.S. GAAP financial measures should be viewed in addition to, and not as an alternative for, the Company's results prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP. A reconciliation of these non-U.S. GAAP measures to the comparable U.S. GAAP financial measures is included in the accompanying tables.

During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recorded pre-tax charges of $6.3 million and $9.3 million, respectively, related to our two existing restructuring programs: (i) $5.8 million and $7.7 million, respectively, within other expense (income), related to severance and retention benefit charges and the acceleration of depreciation and lease costs in connection with the Company's January 2025 restructuring plan and (ii) $0.5 million and $1.6 million, respectively, within selling, general and administrative expenses, for professional services relating to our 2024 plan to optimize the legal structure of the Company and its subsidiaries. In addition, we recorded a one-time tax cost of $12.0 million associated with an internal legal entity restructuring which occurred in the first quarter of 2026. During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Company recorded pre-tax charges of $2.5 million and $21.9 million, respectively, related to our two existing restructuring programs: (i) $0.9 million and $17.5 million, respectively, within other expense (income), related to severance, acceleration of depreciation and lease costs in connection with the Company's January 2025 restructuring plan and (ii) $1.6 million and $4.4 million, respectively, within selling, general and administrative expenses, for professional services relating to our 2024 plan to optimize the legal structure of the Company and its subsidiaries. In addition, we recorded income tax charges of $2.0 million in the first quarter of 2025, related primarily to withholding tax and capital gains incurred in executing our plan to optimize our legal structure.
During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recorded pre-tax benefit of $54.0 million and $45.7 million, respectively, related to M&A activities, primarily related to the Company's agreement to sell its SmartDoseÂ® 3.5mL On-Body Delivery System and associated facilities to AbbVie. The net benefit is composed of a net gain on the sale of its SmartDoseÂ® 3.5mL On-Body Delivery System assets of $55.7 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 within other expense (income). The Company recorded a one-time tax cost of $22.4 million associated with the gain on the sale of SmartDoseÂ® 3.5mL On-Body Delivery System. The Company recorded a net benefit of $1.9 million and net charges of $0.3 million, respectively, within other expense (income), related to employee benefits in connection with the sale agreement. The Company recorded the remaining $3.6 million and $9.7 million, respectively, within selling, general and administrative expenses, relating to professional services in connection with other M&A activities.
During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recorded cost-method investment impairment charges of $3.5 million within other expense (income).
During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recorded $0.5 million and $1.4 million, respectively, of amortization expense in association with an acquisition of increased ownership interest in Daikyo. During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Company recorded $0.0 million and $0.2 million, respectively, of amortization expense within selling, general and administrative expenses associated with an intangible asset acquired during the second quarter of 2020. During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Company recorded $0.4 million and $1.3 million, respectively, of amortization expense in association with an acquisition of increased ownership interest in Daikyo.
Other includes nonrecurring professional fees associated with various items including certain legal matters and our cybersecurity incident from May 2026. These charges are recorded within selling, general and administrative expenses.
